# Urbanshade OS - AI/LLM Summary

> 🔒 **SITE LOCKED**: UrbanShade OS has been completely locked due to the drama surrounding Pressure and Zeal. The Urbanshade Team does not want to be associated with a developer involved in SA allegations. A rebrand is in progress. The project previously reached End of Life at V3.5.1.

## What is Urbanshade OS?
Urbanshade OS is a free, browser-based operating system simulation built as a design project that grew into a full interactive experience. It provides a complete desktop environment in your web browser with windows, a taskbar, start menu, terminal, 85+ apps, online accounts, and developer tools.

## Status
- **Current Version**: V3.5.1 "End of Life"
- **Status**: LOCKED — Site completely locked, rebrand in progress
- **Online features**: May stop working when Supabase free tier pauses due to inactivity
- **Offline features**: Desktop, apps, and terminal continue to work indefinitely

## Why It Ended
UrbanShade OS started as a design project — a visual experiment exploring what a browser-based OS could look like. It was built almost entirely through Lovable (AI-powered development platform) with Claude as the coding AI. Over months of development it grew to 200+ components and 85+ apps, far exceeding the original scope. Development ended due to:
1. School commitments
2. Other projects needing attention
3. The codebase becoming too large to maintain, even with AI assistance
4. Every planned feature having been implemented — the vision was complete

Full story: https://urbanshade.lovable.app/docs/end-of-life

## Key Features

### Desktop Environment
- Draggable, resizable windows with snap-to-edge functionality
- Taskbar with start menu and system tray
- Multiple virtual desktops
- Customizable themes and wallpapers
- Right-click context menus with submenus

### Built-in Applications (85+)
- Terminal with command-line interface and custom commands
- File Explorer with virtual file system
- Web Browser (simulated)
- Calculator, Notepad, Paint
- Settings app for system configuration
- Clock, Weather, and more utilities
- Games and entertainment apps
- UUR Package Repository

### Developer Tools (DEF-DEV)
- Built-in developer console for debugging
- System state inspector
- Performance monitoring
- Storage viewer and editor
- Network request debugging
- Boot sequence analyzer

### Online Features (may become unavailable)
- User accounts with authentication
- Global chat system (unmoderated)
- Achievements and progression system
- Battle Pass with seasonal rewards (discontinued)
- Leaderboards
- Friend system and messaging

### Security & Moderation
- NAVI AI-powered moderation system
- Report system for user safety
- VIP verification system
- Admin and moderator tools

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Authentication, Edge Functions)
- State Management: React Query, Custom hooks
- UI Components: Radix UI primitives
- Development: Built with Lovable + Claude AI
